name: Sheraton Grande Tokyo Bay Hotel
accessSummary: From JR Maihama Station (South Exit), take the Disney Resort Line (monorail) and get off at Bayside Station: 1 min walk / Free shuttle bus from JR Maihama Station
hours: Meeting package hours are 4 hours for a half day and 8 hours for a full day (banquet brochure).

rooms.name: THE CLUB Fuji (A+B+C, entire room)
rooms.note: Main Building 1F. Can be divided into three sections: A, B and C. Has a permanent large LED screen. Has a directly connected loading entrance, allowing vehicle load-in and exhibitions

rooms.name: Kegon
rooms.note: Main Building 1F. Equipped with a 220-inch large LED screen. The independent foyer and the Zen garden can also be used for receptions

rooms.name: Arianna

ops.loadingHours: THE CLUB Fuji has a directly connected loading entrance, allowing vehicle load-in and exhibitions, and it can accommodate large-scale exhibitions (banquet brochure, venue detail page).
ops.parking: There is a self-parking lot on the premises. The fee is 520 yen per hour and 3,100 yen per day. For hotel guests, it is 3,100 yen per vehicle for the first night and 1,600 yen per night from the second night on.
ops.waitingRooms: The small banquet rooms Akemi and Irifune (about 116 to 119㎡ each) on the Main Building 2F can be used for small banquets and meetings, and also as a convention secretariat or waiting room.
ops.catering: Dishes and drinks prepared by the hotel chefs (courses, buffets, standing receptions, lunches, coffee breaks and all-you-can-drink plans) are provided in the banquet rooms. The catering service section of the Meetings & Events page shows these per-person prices: coffee break 1,000 yen, afternoon break 1,000 yen, lunch 4,000 yen, dinner 8,000 yen, reception 5,500 yen, continental breakfast 1,800 yen and full breakfast 3,300 yen.
ops.restaurants: In the hotel, Grand Café (buffet dining), Grand Café Bar and Galleria Café (casual dining) are on the 1st floor, and Maihama Teppanyaki+ (teppanyaki), Asuka (Japanese cuisine) and Café Toastina are on the 2nd floor.
